title.narrative: Technical assistance to the Climate Change Sector Reform Performance Contract in Ethiopia

description.narrative: Contract related to: Technical assistance to the Climate Change Sector Reform Performance Contract in Ethiopia - The Cooperation Facility will help ensure effective and gender responsive implementation of the EU-Ethiopia cooperation, under the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI-Global Europe). Activities will address the need for the development of conflict sensitive and responsive future engagements, intensified strategic communication and public diplomacy activities and stronger coordination with Member States in Team Europe Initiatives (TEIs).The action, with a budget of EUR 2,500,000.00, will fund the procurement of various Technical Assistance services to execute the assignments required to better design and implement future EU development cooperation and related visibility and communication activities in the country.
